scope: Concrete session-private staging plan for one frame item translation discriminator
status: prepared for root and QA review; no staging, shader writes, reloads or fixture calls executed

staging.swap: Verify exact owner, identities, guards and original junction targets; rename each original junction to its fresh backup name; create a junction at the identical original lookup path pointing to the verified session stage. Rename only junction entries, never repository directories.
staging.post_swap_physical_gate: All loaded shader lookup handle-finalpaths must resolve inside the ordinary session stage; file IDs must differ from the original repository file and match the stage file. Reject any repository alias before every shader write.

per_control_required_evidence: exact final serialized Combine palette before and after native call
canonical full palette bytes and SHA
fresh owner-bound native PNG and receipt
finite_execution.capture_backend: Proven single-frame WGC; no foreground or resizing fallback
finite_execution.required_visual_discriminator: Translated item-only moves in expected direction by at least 80 pixels and outside original native body ROI; otherwise the staged reload path is unproven and the combined result remains inconclusive.
finite_execution.failure_policy: Stop normal controls at first binding/reload/palette/capture/guard/budget failure; retain exact evidence, run bounded cleanup only, and do not retry or upgrade acceptance.

restoration.stage_shader: Restore exact original 12899-byte shader in the session stage and explicitly reload while the stage remains the active lookup target; capture the restored combined and item-only controls only if healthy and within budget.
restoration.runtime_state: Restore blueprint workspace, document, camera, in-memory frame profiles, factory wrappers and capture wrapper in reviewed reverse order. Production profiles must all be false and original saved document/profile bytes must match.
restoration.links: Rename each staged lookup junction to its fresh retired-stage name, then rename the preserved original junction back to its original name. Verify both targets and all three handle-finalpaths return to the original repository source.
restoration.post_link_reload: When healthy, explicitly reload the original shader through the restored lookup path; record the exact return and bounded cleanup errors. A failed reload prevents runtime-restored claims.
restoration.filesystem: Verify original pack 709-file path/size/SHA index unchanged, protected root resources unchanged, source/private/generated configs unchanged, and no material/model/texture/native-actor shader edits. Retain ordinary stage and retired junction entries as diagnostic evidence; perform no recursive deletion.
restoration.unhealthy_cleanup: Restore filesystem bytes and original junctions independently of SDK availability; retain explicit unresolved runtime restoration errors and stop only the owner/creation-bound session if root directs.
